waves.title: Wave 6.2: Surgical Security & UK GDPR/KCSIE Hardening
deliverables: Enforced Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private and Pragma: no-cache on /api/* responses in SecurityHeadersMiddleware
Restricted trusted proxy peers strictly to loopback, Docker bridge (172.16.0.0/12), and explicit TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS
Offline breached password screening (_COMMON_BREACHED_PASSWORDS) and username-containment checks in RegisterRequest and ChangePasswordRequest
Pre-flight UK pupil & staff PII safeguarding DLP scanner (UPN, NINO, email, UK phone) on TeacherRequest.topic
Immediate sibling session revocation on user password change with audit logging (revoked_sibling_sessions count)
IP-wide password spray rate limiting (count_ip_failed_logins_since >= 25) with composite index efficiency
Revision resource URL allowlist (sanitise_revision_url), prompt confidentiality canary token guard (_PROMPT_CANARY), and explicit KCSIE safety settings

waves.title: Wave 6.3: Performance & Reconnaissance Hardening
deliverables: Immutable Cache-Control (public, max-age=31536000, immutable) for hashed /assets/* static bundles in SecurityHeadersMiddleware
Minimized unauthenticated GET /api/auth/status payload returning empty allowed_subjects and allowed_task_types lists while preserving registration_mode and maintenance_mode
Code-split StudioWorkspace and AdminDashboard in frontend/src/App.tsx using React.lazy and layout-matched Suspense skeleton
Comprehensive backend and frontend regression suites verifying cache headers, auth status payload minimization, and lazy boundary routing

waves.title: Wave 6.4: Application IP Rate Limiting & DoS Hardening
deliverables: Built-in KeyedSlidingWindow IP rate limiter (default 120 req/min, configurable via IP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE) in backend/app/core/limits.py with memory-bounded LRU eviction
Pure ASGI IpRateLimitMiddleware in backend/app/core/hardening.py protecting all /api/* routes, emitting RFC 9457 application/problem+json 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After and security headers
Spoof-resistant client IP extraction (extract_asgi_client_ip) honoring CF-Connecting-IP exclusively from verified trusted proxy peers (127.0.0.1, Docker bridge, TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS)
Exemption of internal Docker health probes (/health, /health/live, /health/ready) and static assets from IP rate limiting
Global pytest autouse fixture in backend/tests/conftest.py and exhaustive unit/integration tests in backend/tests/test_wave6_2_compliance_hardening.py

waves.title: Wave 6.5: Auth Hardening & Dependency Vulnerability Remediation
deliverables: Pre-validation Argon2id CPU/RAM exhaustion defense in AuthService.register_user validating IP quota, mode, invite codes, and username uniqueness before computing 64 MiB password hash without transaction locks
Per-IP registration sliding window rate limiter (ip_registration_limiter, default 10 per 15 minutes) in backend/app/core/limits.py
State-mutating CSRF origin and Sec-Fetch-Site validation enforced on POST /api/auth/login and POST /api/auth/register

Remediated 5 GitHub Dependabot package vulnerabilities via pyasn1 v0.6.5 upgrade in backend/uv.lock and explicit pyasn1>=0.6.5 pin in backend/pyproject.toml (alerts 68-71) and minimatch v11.0.3 override in frontend/package.json (alert 72)
Exhaustive unit and regression tests in backend/tests/test_wave6_2_compliance_hardening.py verifying zero hashing on invalid inputs, 429 Retry-After rate limits, and 403 CSRF rejections
